nom: Naked Sundays CabanaGlow Glow Drops SPF 50 Sunscreen

avis.texte: I love applying this under a matte foundation. It gives a glow from within effect without looking oily. I've had trouble finding sunscreen that pairs well with make-up. This has been a great solution. I top off with the spf setting spray from the same brand.

I LOVE mineral sunscreens and will try any that have a bit of tint or something to void the whitecast the titanium dioxide and zinc oxide leave behind. I bought both the sheer glow and bronze and both are absolute nots from me. The sheer I was expecting to give a glow but this does not blend into the skin well and left me looking like I did not know how to use liquid highlighter. The bronze drops are very, very orange. I can't overstate how orange. It did look okay when I blended with another sunscreen, but I was hoping for something to use alone and not have to mix. To apply enough for proper 50SPF coverage, this product is not it. Plus you do need to reapply when out in sun, so I'll stick with my powder sunscreen.
Love everything about it light smooth and luxury not bulky you can take it it witg you everywhere
I got the illuminating drops, and it looks more like a liquid highlighter. It is a glittery oily mess. Maybe it could be used as a highlighter on the high points of the face.

I actually dont hate the product but looks better under makeup than on its own. The packaging sucks though. The white lettering on the packaging is coming off & gets all over my hands when im applying the product. The product also gets all over the cap. I have been traveling with it & am so on the fence after my recent trip.
I got the on the 21 days sale and had high hopes. But its soooo glittery that i have to put something on top to tone it down.

avis.titre: Shocked how good! Better makeup application
avis.texte: I bought this during 21 Days Sale. I'm only using mineral sunscreens now. This made my flaky, breakout, textured chin area appear better than EVER after applying shape tape concealer on top. I am so impressed!

I purchased the illuminating version of this product as it was on sale during the 21 days. This has so much mica I was taking a back by it at first I thought it was glitter. The chunks of mica are visible. Not sure who would want that in their sunscreen, lol. Very odd. I'll keep it as it was inexpensive but if I had paid full price, I would definitely be returning this.

avis.titre: A great alt for a skin tint!
avis.texte: This has a surprising amount of color/coverage for the kind of product it is and the bottle is FULL! I wish it were a tad less warm toned, but that's just a me problem
This bronzer gives me a natural looking sun-kissed skin. Love it!
The product was greasy and so sparkly it looked like kid blush. Not a product for working women but might be more appropriate for school age kids.
Love and mineral sunscreen is great compared to other active ingredients in my opinion this is better than the OG drunk elephant drops.

avis.titre: Mini spf mineral trio naked sundays
avis.texte: Loving these glow spf's. In the past I have mixed them with foundations to brighten them up a bit but this time I have just applied after my skin care and loving the result

I have hyperpigmentation and somewhat oily skin, so i love products that include zinc. This is a really pretty shade (peachy pink) and very glowy/sparkly. That said, its highly pigmented and the smallest amount (less than 1 drop) looks super intense on my fair skin. It works if i mix it with beautyscreen, but id rather not have to do that. On a positive note, the bottle will last forever haha It also isnt setting- if I lightly touch my face an hour after i apply it (and setting powder), my finger will still come away with product. Its possible that its not sinking in because i have mineral sunscreen underneath, but im not sure. While this product didnt work for me, i still love naked sundays (especially the beautyscreen) and will probably see if their blush sticks work better for me.
overpriced-bad cheap packaging- does does perform as advertised on pkg
I used these for beach days, they are very translucent but the SPF is really why I bought them anyway. For the cost, I can't say I recommend.
This trip was perfect for my recent trip - these are my daily go to highly recommended
The trio is fun to wear alone or mix to suit the occasion. Great sun protection, feels light on my skin, it provides a healthy glow but does not feel at all greasy.
Nice tint, container size is very reasonable with price, SPF shade is superb.Excellent match for my skin tone
I like the color and luminosity of this product. I don't love the way mineral sunscreens feel on my face, but this one is a little better than most.

avis.titre: A little ashy for my tone but works well
avis.texte: I have a deeper brown skin tone so this is the most flattering and I do get some bronzing.
I love my make up made with NS so not it could be even better

This is my absolute favourite sunscreen that I have used every day for years since I discovered it. It feels great, makes my skin look great, and has kept my face wonderfully burn-free even in very high UV situations. However, It's extremely important to me to use 100% mineral sunscreen, and I've become aware that the environmental working group recently flagged the ingredient butyloctyl salicylate as a potentially problematic ingredient with the properties of a chemical filter, interpretable as an unregulated chemical sunscreen that raises SPF rating without adequately filtering some frequencies of UV. I have observed this ingredient is common in modern formulations and is likely a strong contributor to thisformulas great texture, but I have concerns about it and feel it may be necessary to explore other sunscreen options. Naked Sundaysâ€™ mineral perfecting primer is possibly the next best option but I find the thick texture a bit more difficult to fully embrace.
I like the bronze the best if I was to ever repurchase these. It doesn't leave as much of a white cast and I mix with my foundation, and It's very pigmented.

CabanGlow sheer tint Glow Serum Drops feels light on my skin while providing full sun protection. It is great for days I don't want to wear makeup; it just gives my skin a healthy glow, some moisture and great sun protection.

I wear sunscreen, enough so that I treat it as its own layer on my face. So imagine my surprise when I put it on and saw an orange glow. there is a shockingly high amount of glitter/shimmer in this stuff. I can't use it for proper enough coverage for the sunscreen to work. This product is good for maybe touch ups, but by itself for proper sun protection it's too tinted and glittery.

I live in Florida yet I hate wearing sunscreen on my face. I've tried so many different sunscreen brands and have always had a bad experience with them. The majority of sunscreens burn, pill under makeup, feel greasy or extremely chalky. I read great reviews on the glow serum drops. I purchased sheer tint and illuminating. I liked the sunscreen so much that I purchased four more bottles of the sheer tint. For someone who hates sunscreen, this should tell you all you need to know. I had my mom try the sunscreen and she liked it so much that I gave her one of mine.

This has been my go to this year. I order a new one as soon as I run out. It gives me a lovely glow with no glitter and zero white cast. Unlike other mineral sunscreens, it's not drying. I bought it for some of my friends as well. Highly recommend!
This adds a lovely, subtle glow. Not glittery or yellow, and blends effortlessly. I will definitely be getting more!

I have very sensitive acne prone skin and always go for a natural dewy makeup look and its def worth it i like how it made me glow . Its very lightweight on my skin it kept me moisturized all day and i love that it has spf !! Definitely my go to in my routine now
The expiration is ridiculously short. The product itself is pretty great though

I love this SPF. I use it as more of a makeup than an SPF. I apply it over my normal sunscreen for a little bit of glow and blurring effect. It has the perfect amount of light reflecting for a pearlescent glow. I just re-ordered and got a mini too for travel.

These bronze drops are so lovely! They are a gorgeous shade with lots of pigment. I typically add a drop or two to my moisturizer or even my foundation depending on how much depth I need. I do wish there was a slightly more fair skin friendly â€œ bronzer shade. These are so pigmented, It's easy to end up looking ridiculous if you are too heavy handed. I find the illumination shade works better to warm my base in the winter, but doesn't really have the same effect as the bronzer. There needs to be an additional option in between. I'd also love a pinker highlighter as well. Basically something similar to the effect of Blush and Pearl mixed, with a bit more warmth as well. I have used the bronzer and blush sticks, but those have basically the same issue. So much pigment and not easy to apply and fully blend on fair skin. A wider range of options would be wonderful.

I was so happy with the application of my new favorite Naked Sundays- Cabana Sheer tint ! After prepping my skin after cleansing I was nicely surprised at the texture & sheer coverage of this SPF50. It was not sticky or gooey either! The finished result was a slight opalescent glow without too much of one color. I love it for daytime & a choice of no foundation!

I have used so many mineral sunscreens and have bever used a better one than this one. All the other tinted ones were always so orange and felt so heavy and sticky on the face. I got the sheer version of this and it evens out my skin complexion without adding much color. I have been using it everyday as a primer for under my makeup and it looks AMAZING and it keeps my skin hydrated as well. Doesnt have a weird sunscreen smell either. I will be repurchasing this forever🙏

This product is perfect. It's extremely comfortable and protects extremely well: I am very pale and live in a region with a lot of cloud cover. I used it as my only facial sunscreen on a tropical vacation anddidn't get the faintest hint of a sunburn. It makes my skin look amazing, and I constantly get compliments when I am wearing it. I wear it every single day with great joy.
Truly a gorgeous bronzing color. I use it on my forehead and cheeks over the foundation tint and other products. It's a beautifully color and blends wonderfully!!!!

avis.texte: I made the mistake of using gbis product on irs own. I will not be doing that again. When used alone, it tends to be too glowy and honestly hard to blend effectively. When used with another product, like a tint or foundation, it seemed to sit better on the face.
